conceptZh: 蛋：疋加虫，像一顆孵出小生命的蛋。
object: a rubber dinosaur with huge feet and tiny arms, and a stubborn speckled toy egg
morph: the egg has its own opinion and rolls away from the dino's tiny arms until he outsmarts it with a big foot, forming 蛋
creativeAngle: 橡膠恐龍的小手夠不到愛亂滾的蛋，最後用大腳穩住。
promptEn: An 8-second bright, clean 2D/3D toy-animation clip. Teaching subject: the single Traditional Chinese glyph 蛋 (egg), correctly formed, in a saturated solid color against a much lighter background, ending centered and uncropped at about 70% of frame height with margins. Lead cast: a rubber dinosaur with huge feet and tiny arms, and a stubborn speckled toy egg. Sky-blue backdrop with a thin grass strip; the glyph is sunny golden-orange. Timed beats. 0.0-1.5s: a green rubber dinosaur stomps in with squeaky footsteps; the voice says the first 蛋 as a speckled toy egg drops onto the grass and wobbles. 1.5-3.0s: he reaches with his comically tiny arms; the egg rolls just out of reach, again and again, leaving golden strokes behind in its trail. The voice says the second 蛋 as the egg does a smug little spin. 3.0-4.5s: he lifts one giant foot, pins the egg like a football, and the strokes click into 蛋 at 70% of frame height. 4.5-5.0s: the voice says 雞蛋 (ㄐㄧ ㄉㄢˋ) as the egg cracks open and a fluffy yellow chick pops out. Final hold: 5.0-8.0s: the glyph is still; the chick perches on the dino's head while he sways proudly. The glyph holds fully still and clearly readable for the last 3 seconds. Voice: one gentle off-screen voice in Taiwan-standard Mandarin, slow with crisp tones, reads precisely 蛋、蛋、雞蛋 = ㄉㄢˋ、ㄉㄢˋ、ㄐㄧ ㄉㄢˋ, character, character, word, and nothing after it. Keep any background music quieter than the voice. The vocabulary word is audio only. The glyph 蛋 is the only text on screen: no subtitles, captions, labels, watermark, logos, clutter, flashing or strobing effects, and no real people or realistic human figures; all characters are stylized toys or cartoon animals.

conceptZh: 玩具戰士為了搶花生抱著的一疊搖搖晃晃的玩具蛋，揮泡棉劍卻把自己轉得頭暈，兩人「咚」地撞頭後，飛出去的蛋一顆顆落下堆成「蛋」字。
object: a wobbling tower of glossy speckled toy eggs hugged by a cartoon raccoon, coveted by a chunky toy warrior with a foam sword and round shield
morph: the head-BONK launches the eggs; each egg cracks mid-air into a tomato-red stroke-shaped piece that lands stacked, 疋 on top and 虫 below, forming 蛋
creativeAngle: 上一版是橡膠恐龍追蛋、蛋殼孵小雞的安靜變身；這版改成本輪指定的「友好對決」：玩具戰士和浣熊花生為了一疊蛋比劍，兩人都揮空自轉、撞頭坐倒，撞擊把蛋震飛並堆成字，最後握手。「雞蛋」一詞由發條母雞跳出來下蛋敲中頭盔來對畫，三句語音各對應一個清楚動作。
promptEn:
An 8-second bright, clean toy-animation clip, cheerful cartoon slapstick, soft daylight, no dark grading. Teaching subject: the single Traditional Chinese glyph 蛋 (egg), correctly formed with 疋 on top and 虫 below, in saturated tomato red against a pale butter-cream backdrop, ending centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with margins. Only two characters: a chunky toy warrior (oversized plastic helmet, foam sword, round shield, enormous confidence, zero skill) and Peanut, a cartoon raccoon sidekick hugging a wobbling tower of glossy speckled toy eggs far taller than himself.

0.0-1.5s: The warrior struts in from the left, plants his feet and points his foam sword straight at the egg tower on the right. Peanut salutes at the wrong moment and the tower sways. The voice says the first 蛋 as the top egg teeters and bobs.

1.5-3.0s: Huge wind-up: the warrior swings so hard he misses by a mile and spins himself around three full times, helmet sliding over his eyes. Peanut swings back with an egg-carton lid, misses too, and spins the opposite way, eggs orbiting above his head.

3.0-4.5s: A frozen beat as both stagger toward each other, dizzy and cross-eyed. BONK: their heads bump with a rubbery boink, squash-and-stretch, and they flop down on their bottoms. Sword, shield and all the eggs fly upward. Each egg cracks mid-air into a red stroke-shaped piece and drops into place: the 疋 pieces first, then the 虫 pieces beneath, snapping together into 蛋 as the voice says the second 蛋.

4.5-5.5s: The voice says 雞蛋 (ㄐㄧ ㄉㄢˋ) as a wind-up toy hen pops out of Peanut's hat, clucks once, and lays one last egg that drops onto the warrior's helmet with a soft bonk. The glyph stays fully visible behind them.

5.0-8.0s final hold: the glyph 蛋 holds perfectly still, centered and readable for the last 3 seconds. In the lower corners, well away from the strokes, the dazed warrior and Peanut grin, shake hands, and the hen perches proudly on the shield.

Audio: one warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwan-standard Mandarin, slow, with crisp distinct tones, reads exactly these syllables and nothing after them: 蛋、蛋、雞蛋 (ㄉㄢˋ、ㄉㄢˋ、ㄐㄧ ㄉㄢˋ), character, character, word. Only gentle cartoon sound effects; any music quieter than the voice. The vocabulary word is audio only. The glyph 蛋 is the only text on screen: no subtitles, captions, labels, watermark, logos, clutter or flashing effects. All characters are stylized toys or cartoon animals; no real people or realistic human figures.
